plans.name: The call
plans.verdict: Best plan that costs no hit.

plans.name: Add Mbeumo for -4
plans.verdict: Projects +0.2 against the call after the -4. A hit needs to beat the best free plan by 2 points to be worth it, so this one does not.

plans.name: Mbeumo instead of Tavernier
plans.verdict: 0.7 behind the call over six gameweeks. Mbeumo is in 22% of teams near your rank against 60% for Tavernier, so it is the more differential version.

plans.name: Gabriel only, roll one
plans.verdict: Keeps a second free transfer for GW11, but keeps Szoboszlai, who expects 32 minutes a game, for another week. 6.8 behind the call.

plans.name: Roll both
plans.verdict: Gives up about 14 projected points over six gameweeks for 3 free transfers in GW11.

chips.label: Free Hit (first set)
chips.when: GW18 or GW19, decided on 26 Dec
chips.why: No blanks before GW19, so it is about cover for the festive run, when three deadlines fall in seven days.

chips.label: Wildcard
chips.when: Around GW31, just before the forecast doubles
chips.why: Builds a squad with double-gameweek players for GW32 and GW35 or 36, then rides it into the Bench Boost.

chips.label: Bench Boost
chips.when: The biggest double: GW32, or GW35 or 36
chips.why: All 15 players count, so it pays most when most of your squad plays twice.

chips.label: Free Hit
chips.why: Fields a full eleven in a week when many teams have no game, without wrecking your squad.

chips.label: Triple Captain
chips.when: A premium with two good fixtures in one double
chips.why: Two games at triple points. Pick it once the doubles are confirmed and you can see the fixtures.
